The '''Imperial Office of Logistics''' was a department of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was part of the [[Imperial Civil Service]], and [[Adana Vermor]] served as an [[Imperial Economics Advisor]] to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
